These whispers be comin' from Matt Ryan, the voice actor behind Assassin’s Creed Black Flag's swashbucking stabber Edward Kenway. He's cheekily told some landlubbers that they may have to beat the game again, prompting the parrots to start squawking about a return to the Carribean yet again.
Read more
articles.title: Rumoured Assassin’s Creed Black Flag remake teased by actor who's pretty chill about loose lips sinking ships

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
Balls have never been footed so fast. Rematch, the moreish multiplayer soccer game from the developers of Sifu, has seen its first cases of speedhackers infesting the game over the last week. 
It's not unusual for multiplayer games to suffer a few cheaters, and it's not clear how widespread the hacking tools are being used among the growing number of players (now at 3 million players, according to Sloclap). But it is a mild concern to anyone who prefers their team mates and opponents to move at regular human pace, and not say, the speed of an angry motorcycle, as shown in footage captured by several players. 
Read more
articles.title: Rematch has a mild case of hackers moving at cheetah speeds

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Update: Eric 'ConcernedApe' Barone has confirmed to RPS that the DM exchange between him and a Hytale fan about a possible revival is genuine, but says it was "not a public message that I was trying to convey".
"I'm not actively doing anything to make this happen," he continued, "If something were presented to me, I would be open to entertaining the idea, that's all. It's not something I am thinking about too much, since I'm focused on working on my next game."
Original story follows:
Following Minecrafty sandbox game Hytale's recent cancellation, the original founder of Hypixel Studios has said that he plans to reach out to Riot Games in an effort to buy back the game and release a version of it.
Meanwhile, Stardew Valley creator Eric 'ConcernedApe' Barone has seemingly responded to a fan asking him if he'd be open to getting involved in efforts to ressurect the game.
Read more
articles.title: Hytale studio founder says he'll reach out to Riot in an effort to buy back and revive the game

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
Welcome, friend, to the good year of 2025. Scavengers Reign has just been renewed for its third season, Greggs have starting doing their festive bake all year round, and the Dead Space remake sold gangbusters.
Wait, no, sorry. This is the bad timeline. Scavengers Reign was acquired by a company who actively balk at anything people might want to watch with their entire faces, and Dead Space apparently didn't sell well enough for EA to greenlight more. It's with a certain melancholy then, that I recommend the Steam Summer sale's offering of Dead Space remake at 80% off (£10/€12/$12/perhaps a sillier price if you live somewhere Valve doesn't consider important).
Deep discounts aren't always a sure indicator of success in either direction, of course. The brilliant Resident Evil 4 remake is 50% off its already very generous usual price and apparently did very well. But I can't help get abandoned bargain bin vibes from this one. It deserved so much better.
 Read more
articles.title: The Dead Space remake is brilliantly, devastatingly 80% off in the Steam sale

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
This week in PC gaming news my flat continues to feel like a fondue served in a grizzly bear's armpit. Readers in equatorial latitudes may sneer at what we in the UK are pleased to call a "heatwave", but you have to remember that British people are all descended from ice trolls, and that we live in small volcanoes dug out by steampunk druids who thought the glaciers would return sometime in the year 1963.
There is only one way to escape the sun's hatred round these parts, and that is by immersing yourself in some kind of interactive entertainment product, while strenuously pretending that you no longer have skin. Here are some new releases.
 Read more
articles.title: This week in PC games: Mecha Break, ICE protest charity bundles and vibrant ostrich farming

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
I have thus far in my life avoided playing any factory automation games because I only ever see them recommended in the same breath as dire warnings and laments. "Play Infinifactory! It ruined my life! ", "I now exclusively play Opus Magnum inside the skip that is now my home after my family kicked me out. 10/10!", etc etc. But the way Number Machine's extendo-arm hex pushes sets of tiles has awakened something in me. Taking a sprawling genre and making it tiny and a bit pastel is basically a genre unto itself now but one I'm a supporter of. Here's a trailer.
Read more
articles.title: Number Machine looks like it does for factory automation what Mini Motorways did for city builders

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jiří Sluka)
articles.description: Pravidelná sonda do světa software. Podíváme se na nástroj pro import grafických assetů z Figmy do zdrojáku, budeme přenášet data mezi databázemi a nakonec si přesuneme playlisty např. z foobar2000 do Plexu.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (9. 7. 2025): přeneste data mezi databázemi i platformami

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Ukážeme si základní vlastnosti knihovny FAISS, která je určena pro vyhledávání vektorů (s vysokými počty dimenzí) na základě jejich podobnosti. Tato knihovna se používá třeba při zpracování přirozeného jazyka.
articles.title: FAISS: knihovna pro rychlé a efektivní vyhledávání podobných vektorů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Kopřiva)
articles.description: V dnešním díle Postřehů se podíváme na kybernetický útok na nemocnici v Nymburku, rizika spojená s QR kódy ve phishingových e-mailech nebo zákaz působení čínské společnosti Hikvision v Kanadě.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: další česká nemocnice zasažena kyberútokem

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Google daroval protokol A2A nadaci Linux Foundation. Ubuntu 25.10 zvyšuje požadavky na architekturu RISC-V. Debian vydal druhou testovací verzi instalačního programu pro připravované vydání „Trixie“.
articles.title: Google daroval protokol A2A, Ubuntu mění podporu RISC-V

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Týden v GNOME: Papers hotové, nový výchozí prohlížeč PDF, Coreboot 25.06 s podporou Xeon Emerald Rapids a vylepšeními pro Panther Lake, Windows 12 se zpozdí, Microsoft chystá další aktualizaci Windows 11.
articles.title: KDE vylepšuje HiDPI škálování, Intel Lunar Lake na Linuxu opět zrychlí

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Tento příspěvek navazuje na diskuzi u předchozího článku. Ta se týkala o tom, zda má či nemá C++ destructive move, jaké výhody a problémy to přináší. Upozorňuji dopředu, že lze očekávat Rust vs C++ flamewar.
articles.title: Destructive Move v C++?

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Intel chystá PTC, „Throttling Control Interface“, AMD připravuje opravy výpočetního ovladače pro Polaris a Hawaii, podpora Apple x86 Touch Bar a Apple Magic Keyboard USB-C v jádru Linux 6.17.
articles.title: Jádro Linux 6.17 s obskurními novinkami: podpora Intel DG1 a naopak definitivní konec OpenMoko

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Počítače IBM PC sice mohly být vybaveny matematickým koprocesorem, ovšem v prvním desetiletí existence této platformy se v žádném případě nejednalo o standardní modul; mnohá PC jím vybavena nebyla.
articles.title: Výpočty v systému pevné řádové čárky na platformě IBM PC

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Sonda do světa otevřeného softwaru. Dnes si trochu zakvízujeme, vyzkoušíme simulátor starých kalkulaček, vylepšíme si slovní zásobu v angličtině a řekneme si o grafickém rozhraní pro ClamAV.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (2. 7. 2025): procvičte si anglickou slovní zásobu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Seznámíme se základy použití frameworku Llama Stack, který je určen pro tvorbu aplikací a nástrojů vybavených generativní AI. Do této oblasti spadají i známé velké jazykové modely jako ChatGPT, Gemini nebo Cursor.
articles.title: Llama Stack: framework pro tvorbu aplikací s generativní AI

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Digitální audio stanice Ardour se rozhodla přechod na GTK3 či GTK4 neřešil stylem GIMPu, tedy patlat se s tím deset let, místo toho dostává Ardour vlastní fork GTK+ v2, zjednodušenou verzi, kterou projekt ladil od začátku loňského roku.
articles.title: Ardour už bez podpory GTK+ v2, přešel na vlastní fork YTK

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Čekání na Thunderbird 140 skončilo. S ním do tohoto poštovního klienta přichází několik vylepšení UI i věcí v pozadí aplikace. Jednou z novinek je tmavý režim, který nyní automaticky adaptuje zprávy na tmavý vzhled. Vývojáři dále přidali nativní notifikace v OS, fungují na Windows, Linuxu i macOS a lze přímo z nich rychle mazat / archivovat či používat uživatelské akce.
articles.title: Thunderbird 140 „Eclipse“ je nové ESR vydání oblíbeného pošťáka

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Český mobilní operátor Vodafone nabízí limitovanou edici předplacené SIM karty Vodafone Giga karta, kterou nyní pořídíte za 225 Kč. Za tuto cenu získáte na prvních 30 dnů mobilní data s objemem 100 GB. Kromě toho můžete i telefonovat za 4,50 Kč za minutu a posílat SMS za 1,90 Kč. Akční nabídka platí pouze do vyprodání zásob.
articles.title: Vodafone nabízí SIM kartu se 100 GB dat za 225 Kč

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: johny)
articles.description: Google koncom júna 2025 predstavil Gemini CLI, open-source AI agenta, ktorý prináša modelu Gemini 2.5 Pro priamo do terminálu. Tento nástroj je určený najmä pre programátorov a technických používateľov, ktorí preferujú prácu v príkazovom riadku pred grafickými rozhraniami.
articles.title: Gemini CLI: nový AI nástroj od Google pre terminál

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Byla vydána nová verze balíku OBS Studio 31.1 a s ní do linuxového světa přichází další vylepšení podpory běhu s PipeWire. Konkrétně jde o podporu Explicit Sync. Dále na Linuxu přibývá podpora vícestopých videí, vylepšena je též podpora hardwarové akcelerace prohlížeče (na GPU Nvidia ve výchozím nastavení vypnuté, kvůli problémům s nekonzistencí chování na různých verzích ovladače Nvidia a také rozličných GPU).
articles.title: OBS Studio 31.1 přináší Explicit Sync pro zachytávání obrazovky s PipeWire

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jáma lvová)
articles.description: Letní tábor Jáma lvová je zaměřen na informatiku, matematiku, programování, logiku a přírodní vědy. Je určen především žákům druhého stupně základních škol a odpovídajících ročníků víceletých gymnázií, kteří se zajímají o technické myšlení a hledají možnosti, jak rozvíjet své dovednosti i během prázdnin. Akce vychází z tradice stejnojmenné korespondenční soutěže, kterou pořádá České vysoké učení technické v Praze.
articles.title: ČVUT pořádá letní tábor Jáma lvová 2025

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Jak jsme již psali, systémová knihovna Glibc 2.41 z bezpečnostních důvodů odmítá otevřít dynamické knihovny .so, které mají nastavený zásobník jako spustitelný.
articles.title: Knihovna Glibc 2.41 dorazila do Gentoo, jak na problémy

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Po třech letech od vydání populárního shellu Bash 5.2 v sobotu vyšla verze 5.3. Nová je substituce příkazu, která provede příkaz v kontextu aktuálního shellu. Existují dvě formy, jedna čte výstup substituce a druhá očekává výstup v proměnné REPLY. Readline má nově podporu nerozlišování malých a velkých písmen (case insensitivity).
articles.title: Nový Bash 5.3 je napsaný tak, aby vyhovoval i standardu C23

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Do Fedory 43 bylo navrženo ukončit podporu UEFI na discích s oddíly MBR pro x86 v instalátoru Anaconda. Nově budou muset být použity oddíly GPT pro UEFI instalace.
articles.title: Fedora chce ukončit podporu UEFI na MBR

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Tomáš Heřmánek)
articles.description: Společnost initMAX pořádá bezplatné webináře věnované novému Zabbixu 7.4.
articles.title: Webináře zdarma k nové verzi Zabbix 7.4

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Chcete se stát odborníky na monitoring pomocí systému Zabbix? Nabízíme pětidenní kurz Zabbix, který probíhá online a je zaměřen na řešení praktických problémů. Kurz je dotován Úřadem práce, od kterého můžete získat až 82 % ceny kurzu. Kontaktujte naši kolegyni pavla.hettnerova@iinfo.cz.
articles.title: Pětidenní kurz Zabbix dotovaný Úřadem práce

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Collin Richards oznámil verzi 0.0.1 utility Tmux-rs, což je implementace terminálového multiplexeru Tmux v jazyce Rust. Přepis trval šest měsíců a zhruba 67 000 řádek napsaných v C se podařilo proměnit asi v 81 000 řádek v Rustu. Ptáte se mě, proč přepisuju Tmux do Rustu? Nemám na to odpověď, je to koníček. Asi jako zahradničení, ale s více segfaulty, popisuje autor projektu.
articles.title: Tmux-rs je nová implementace multiplexeru Tmux přepsaná v jazyce Rust

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Byly odhaleny dvě bezpečnostní chyby v utilitě sudo pro unixové operační systémy, které umožňují místním uživatelům zvýšit svá oprávnění až na úroveň roota.
articles.title: Kritická zranitelnost v sudo umožňuje uživatelům získat práva roota

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Free Software Foundation (FSF) je pod dlouhodobým DDoS útokem. Útoky začaly již loni v létě a pokračují i nadále. I přes probíhající útoky infrastruktura gnu.org, ftp.gnu.org a savannah.gnu.org funguje v podstatě normálně.
articles.title: Free Software Foundation je pod dlouhodobým DDoS útokem

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: O jádře s podporou PREEMPT_RT pro Raspberry Pi jsme tu již psali. Jádro pro Raspberry Pi 3–5 by mělo snížit latenci a pomoci interaktivitě úloh. Dříve bylo potřeba experimentální jádro instalovat pomocí skriptu  rpi-update.
articles.title: Experimentální jádro s PREEMPT_RT pro Raspberry Pi jako balíček

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Artix Linux  je distribuce založená na Arch Linuxu, která nepoužívá systemD (nabízí runit, OpenRC a jiné). Nově má testovací obraz ISO s XLibre místo X.Org. XLibre je asi měsíc starý fork X.Org, za kterým stojí Enrico Weigelt. Ten nebyl spokojený s vývojem X.Org.
articles.title: Artix Linux má testovací obraz s XLibre

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: johny)
articles.description: GitHub Copilot Spaces je nová funkcia, ktorá umožňuje centralizovať a organizovať všetok relevantný kontext pre AI projekty na jednom mieste – či už ide o kód, dokumentáciu, špecifikácie, poznámky, Slack diskusie alebo vlastné inštrukcie.
articles.title: GitHub Copilot Spaces vytvára online AI hub

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Ostré vydání Debianu Trixie se blíží. Raspberry Pi již testuje Trixie jako betu. Ještě nejsou pro Trixie všechny balíky, například Wolfram Mathematica. Time for some remodeling. Screenshot by Destructoid


Helping the Thin Man is a two-part objective in the Suburbia map. He's located in the totally-not-haunted house behind the spawn in Suburbia, which you can find by grinding or jumping on a railing near the decorated ramps, or just by turning around when dropping.


Standing near this mysterious stranger ends up with him asking for an axe (subtle!), and he sucker punches you if you get too close. But if you're looking for some goals to complete before unlocking the next arena, here's how you can help him in THPS 3+4—even if he is kind of a jerk.


Helping the Thin Man in Suburbia in Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4


You have my skate. And his axe. Screenshot by Destructoid


To help the Thin Man, you first need an axe. Find it by the construction site to the front-right of the spawn, where the letter E in S-K-A-T-E is. Grind a short rail close to the ground, pick up the axe, and return to the Thin Man.


Once you've handed him the axe, the Thin Man will do his best Jack Torrance impression and tear down the wall leading inside the house. From there, you can trick into a new area. The fact that the first gap you encounter is called I Got a Bad Feeling About This is probably nothing to be alarmed about.


Screenshot by Destructoid


The new area is a good spot for doing tricks, but more importantly, it leads straight into the Secret Tape for Suburbia. Break the window onto the top floor of the house, then go straight ahead and grind the American flag to get the Secret Tape and knock out some progress toward your next goal. Is it still an abandoned house if there's someone locked in as a prisoner?

The very first location of Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 allows you to become a bit of a public nuisance by soaking the Foreman for an additional trophy.


While the individual is minding his own business and looking after the operations at the plant, you can choose to create a bit of mischief. It's pretty easy to locate him, which is one part of the task. To complete the objective, you'll have to make him fall into the pool of water. However, you can't just grab or push him in it (no, the Doom Man character also doesn't have that privilege), and this guide will help you with the exact steps.


Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 Soaking the Foreman explained


To find the Foreman, stick to the walls on the right of the Foundry and go down from the upper level. You'll find a ramp going up to the second floor in front of you. Take the ramp, and you'll reach the water storage.


Screenshot by Destructoid


The Foreman is standing in front of it (pretty nice positioning), but you can't push him. If you skate behind him, you'll make him stagger, and he will express his frustration. To throw him down in the water, you'll have to skate on the rails behind him.


To do so, reach the rails and jump onto them. You can perform a wide range of moves on the rails, and there's no specific one to target. As long as you're skating on the rails behind him, it's good enough. Once you do so, a crane pulley will swing, knocking the Foreman down into the water.


It's a pretty hilarious task, to say the least. As the Foreman falls into the water, he will rant at you. However, you can just complete your skate and score as high as possible to unlock the next region. There are also a couple of collectibles you can grab at the Foundry, which will add to your final score, making it easier to access new parks.

articles.title: Sky TV Piracy Pair Arrested & IPTV Servers Seized After UK Police Raids

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every week we take a close look at the most pirated movies on torrent sites. What are pirates downloading? 'Thunderbolts' tops the chart, followed by 'Ballerina'. 'Heads of State' completes the top three.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 07/07/2025

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
In a case being heard at a California court, domain registrar Dynadot has partially declined to cooperate with the disclosure requirements of a DMCA subpoena, claiming immunity as a conduit service provider. In response, a copyright holder has asked the Court to issue an order clarifying service providers' safe harbor protection. The case is certainly unusual but also forms part of a more complex set of events, that may ultimately culminate in a potential moment of clarity.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Registrar Snubs DMCA Subpoena, Claims Passive Conduit Immunity

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A court in Brazil has handed down prison sentences totaling 14 years to three individuals for money laundering offenses linked to a pirate IPTV service. A software developer who made the service available through a popular IPTV app, his sister, and a mutual friend handled thousands of transactions through bank accounts, with funds laundered through a small hosting company.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV Trio Sentenced to 14 Years Prison For Money Laundering

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
After more than a decade of timely updates, Google Search's takedown transparency report has stalled since mid-April. The absence of new data makes it harder for journalists and researchers to analyze these DMCA takedown efforts, which have increased significantly over the past year and a half. Notably, Google continues to send these notices to the Lumen database, providing some ongoing visibility.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Google’s DMCA Transparency Report ‘Freezes’ After Recent Volume Surge

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
After successfully fending off three subpoenas from filmmakers seeking user data related to piracy discussions, Reddit is back in federal court. The company is now requesting over $55,000 in legal compensation, suggesting that these repeated requests amount to an "anti-piracy publicity campaign" that chills lawful speech by Reddit’s users.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Reddit Claims Anti-Piracy Subpoenas Are a “Publicity Campaign,” Seeks $55K in Fees

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Post-apocalyptic horror film '28 Years Later' is doing well at the box office, with $100 million in revenue in its first two weeks. The latest installment in the horror franchise also renewed interest in the previous films, with '28 Weeks Later' showing up in various streaming charts. The original '28 Days Later' is less widely available due to licensing issues, so many have turned to pirate sites instead.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ’28 Days Later’ is a Hit on Pirate Sites… 23 Years Later

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
In a letter to Italy's Minister of Foreign Affairs, Antonio Tajani, the European Commission acknowledges Italy's work against online piracy. However, concerns remain over aspects of the Piracy Shield system, potential non-compliance with the Digital Services Act, and the fundamental right to freedom of expression. The letter follows submissions by tech and telecoms advocacy group CCIA, voicing concerns over safeguards, transparency, and cross-border content removal.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Piracy Shield Concerns Prompt EU Commission to Engage Italian Govt.

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The European Commission's Eurostat website has been exploited by third parties who used it to advertise shady IPTV services. The straightforward SEO 'hack' aimed to rank well for various IPTV-related searches, including the top position for "best IPTV providers of 2025". To make matters worse, it confused AI, leading it to suggest that the EU was offering IPTV advice 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Official EU Website Exploited to Advertise Shady IPTV Services

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The U.S. Supreme Court announced today that it will take up a landmark piracy liability lawsuit between Cox Communications and several record labels. The Court granted Cox's petition for a writ of certiorari. It review the contributory infringement standards that determine how ISPs should respond to pirating subscribers, as well as the associated willfulness finding. The record labels' cross-petition was denied.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Supreme Court Grants Cox’s Bid to Reexamine Liability for Pirating Subscribers

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
With an upfront payment starting around $200, buyers can pick up a set-top box and an IPTV subscription that lasts forever, at least as far as the sales pitch is concerned. Thanks to pervasive affiliate marketing, one of the most visible brands right now is Tanggula. Less visible are mounting lawsuits against Tanngula vendors, including a new complaint that strikes beyond local sellers.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Tanggula ‘Free Forever’ IPTV Boxes Keep Costing Sellers Big Money

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
In 2023, Mark Brockley  made headlines after he fled the UK with his dog rather than stand trial for reselling pirate IPTV subscriptions. Brockley was arrested at Barcelona Airport last Friday and, after being found guilty in his absence two years ago, a five-year prison sentence awaits in the UK. Meanwhile, police recollection of Brockley's offending seems subject to change; his status, the nature of the business, even the money made becoming more serious with the passing of time.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV Man Back to Serve 5 Years Prison as Crimes Seem to Get Worse

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
VPN providers typically offer security and privacy as a service. They make it difficult for outsiders, including ISPs, to monitor users' activities. Instead, they require subscribers to trust them with their online traffic. VP.net, a new provider, takes a different approach. The company promises 'cryptographically verifiable privacy' by using special hardware 'safes' (Intel SGX), so even the provider can't track what its users are up to. Trust in technology and hardware is still required, of course.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: New VPN Service Can’t Log Users by Design

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Over the past 18 months, media reports concerning live sports piracy have systematically demonized the Fire TV Stick, hoping to pressure Amazon into action against pirate apps. Amazon doesn't allow infringing apps on its official store, so users manually sideload apps available elsewhere on the internet. In a rare event earlier this week, at least two pirate apps sideloaded by users onto Fire TV devices, were remotely and irreversibly disabled by Amazon.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Amazon Remote Disables Piracy Apps Sideloaded on Fire TV Devices

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The draft of Rep. Darrell Issa's new U.S. pirate site blocking bill 'ACPA' is not without controversy. In public comments, opponents warn that the bill's legal framework risks overblocking, which can impact legitimate sites and services. And in a new twist, it appears the bill may come with a potential self-destruct button: a "sunsetting clause".
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Fears of “Overblocking” Unite Critics of U.S. Pirate Site Blocking Bill

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In a pivotal moment for artificial intelligence and copyright law, Meta has secured a bittersweet partial fair use victory in its defense of a 'piracy' lawsuit filed by several book authors. While granting Meta summary judgment on specific claims, the court outlined how copyright challenges against AI developers might succeed in the future. The decision emphasizes the critical importance of proving potential market harm, specifically by AI-generated books.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Meta Secures Bittersweet Fair Use Victory in AI ‘Piracy’ Case

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Last month, Italian authorities issued fines to more than 2,200 subscribers of a pirate IPTV service busted in October 2024. Another service, Italia TV, was dismantled last December and its main operator has just been sent to prison for 52 months. For the service's 6,000 subscribers, news that an additional prosecutor has been working to identify them is a negative. In Italy, similar cases appear to be backing up.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: €850K IPTV Piracy Haul Ends in 4+ Years in Prison & 6,000 Users Facing Fines

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
For many thousands of Albanians, Filma24 was the top destination for pirated movies and TV shows. This weekend, however, that routine came to an abrupt halt when the site and many of its backup domains went offline. All signs point to an intervention from anti-piracy group ACE and parent organization the Motion Picture Association (MPA), which is the new owner of Filma24's domain names.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ACE Shuts Down Filma24, Albania’s Movie Piracy Juggernaut

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (sdelamarre)
articles.description:
We are happy to announce that ScummVM now supports Adibou 2: Nature & Sciences, a 1998 expansion of Coktel Vision's Adibou 2.
While the original Adibou 2 game focused on reading and mathematics, Nature & Sciences explores new topics: history, geography, science & technology, the countryside, and everyday life. Each subject features six playful educational activities. Please note that the 3D car driving minigame is unfortunately not supported in our ScummVM reimplementation, as it was based on a different engine from the rest of the game.
To help us during the testing period, dig out your Nature & Sciences CD, grab a daily build and read our testing guidelines. You will also need an existing installation from the base Adibou 2: Environment CD, and to copy the contents of your Nature & Sciences CD into a freely named subdirectory of the main game directory, as described in our wiki. Then, register the expansion in-game via the "Land of Knowledge" screen, and start collecting sweets as you complete Adibou's activities…or encourage a young relative to do so! Hardworking players may even earn a diploma upon completing a module, which they can proudly display in their room!
>
articles.title: Off to Adibou's Land of Sciences!

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (Alikhan)
articles.description:
Do you want to expose the deepest secrets of the Tremendous Corporation® and save the games industry? Are you interested in helping a young man who's out of order in an alien future? Or will you join the story of Nathan, who wants to get a second chance in life?
If you answered "yes", then get ready, as we are happy to announce full support for all games based on the SLUDGE engine. The original work began back in 2017, by one of our GSoC students, Simei Yin. Now, after many years of development, the following games are available for public testing:
Above The Waves
Cubert Badbone, P.I.
Frasse And The Peas Of Kejick
The Game That Takes Place On a Cruise Ship
The Interview
Lepton's Quest
Life Flashes By
Mandy Christmas Adventure
Nathan's Second Chance
Out of Order
Robin's Rescue
The Secret of Tremendous Corporation
Essentially, this is the list of all the SLUDGE-based games we know of.
So download your free copies of the games from our game downloads page and use a daily development build to start playing. If you encounter any issues, please submit bug reports to our issue tracker.
Finally, please contact us if you are aware of other games using SLUDGE, variant releases, or releases that are not getting detected properly.
>
articles.title: SLUDGE-based games are ready for testing

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (Bosca)
articles.description:
Paris, July 24, 1914. We are excited to announce that Jordan Mechner's acclaimed real-time adventure The Last Express is now ready for testing in ScummVM!
Step into the shoes of Robert Cath, an American doctor on the run from murder charges, as he boards the legendary Orient Express for what would be its final journey before the outbreak of World War I.
What makes this adventure game truly unique is its time-based gameplay - the game takes place in real time, and characters move within the train following their own schedules, speaking in their native languages, and living their lives whether you're watching or not. But don't worry... you can always rewind time if you missed anything important!
To test this game, you'll need the original version of the game (either from the original hybrid DOS/Windows/Mac CDs or from GOG.com) and a daily development build of ScummVM. Please note that the Gold Edition available from Steam is NOT supported - only the original version is compatible at this time. The engine supports the following languages for the game: English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish. We couldn't locate the Japanese version at the moment, but please contact us if you have it!
Grab a daily build, have our testing guidelines handy, and get ready for an incredible journey through history, mystery, and one of the most innovative adventure games of the 1990s — and besides... the Orient Express is such a beautiful train, wouldn't you want to take some screenshots while you're there?
>
articles.title: All aboard! The Last Express is ready for testing!

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (DreamMaster)
articles.description:
A young physics professor named Lester conducts a particle experiment. Suddenly, something goes wrong, lightning strikes, and in a moment Lester finds himself in a strange alien world. Now he must fight for his life in this strange place. Luckily, he'll find help along the way..
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce full support for Out of this World (aka Another World). This is particularly noteworthy, since the original version of this engine was briefly added to ScummVM over twenty years ago. 
Help us test the game by grabbing a daily build. Read through our testing guidelines. Currently, only the original DOS and Windows 3.1 versions are supported, though with sounds effects only, and not the music. Also, unfortunately, the Anniversary Editions are not yet supported. Additionally, like the original, you can't save your game, but you can use the 'c' key to open an area select dialog to enter a code to resume where you left off. And please take some screenshots along the way.
Lester's fate is in your hands. You'll deal with dangerous fauna, bloodthirsty aliens, and fiendish puzzles as you flee for your life.
>
articles.title: A whole new world. A new fantastic point of view.

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (Alikhan)
articles.description:
It's been seven months since the first few qdEngine games were supported. After further work on the engine and playtesting, we are pleased to announce support for the remaining games:
Little Longnose (Russian: Карлик Нос, Lithuanian: Nykštukas Nosis)

We are also still looking for a Lithuanian copy of the Little Longnose game (Nykštukas Nosis). If you have a copy or know where to obtain one, it would be greatly appreciated by the team.

(Tento post není o filmu)
Znáte jistě Kafkův "Proces", Adamsova "Stopařova průvodce po galaxii" nebo Gilliamův film Brazil. Téma rozbujelé byrokracie, která komplikuje řešení čehokoliv, je velmi vděčné. Ale dnes, kdy se tyto procesy přenesly do online chatů, kde jsou aktivně rozdmýchávány za pomoci AI chatbotů a cizinců, kteří se s vámi baví pomocí strojového překladače (používajícího česká slova "Áno" a "Ďekujeme"), bylo dosaženo dokonalosti.
Včera jsme si koupili vysavač Dyson a zodpovědně jsem se ho pokusil zaregistrovat na oficiálních stránkách, jak mě důrazně upozorňoval přiložený leták se sériovým kódem výrobku. Což nešlo, protože stránka hlásila, že "tento kód není validní". Klikl jsem tudíž na "WhatsApp chat s naší podporou" a započal úžasný příběh:

Sérii screenshotů nutno rozkliknout, případně kliknout sem pro velkou verzi.
Pointa: Podařilo se mi nakonec sehnat lokální české telefonní číslo Dysonu a tam mi řekli, že vysavač nikde registrovat nemusím a v případě reklamace mi stačí faktura od Alzy.

USN-7412-1 fixed vulnerabilities in GnuPG. The update introduced a
regression. This update fixes the problem.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Original advisory details:

 It was discovered that GnuPG incorrectly handled importing keys with
 certain crafted subkey data. If a user or automated system were tricked
 into importing a specially crafted key, a remote attacker may prevent 
 users from importing other keys in the future.
articles.title: USN-7412-2: GnuPG regression

articles.description:
Avi Halachmi discovered that Git incorrectly managed file modification
constraints with Gitk. An attacker could possibly use this issue to create
or write to arbitrary files on the system. (CVE-2025-27613)

Avi Halachmi discovered that Git incorrectly handled arguments when
invoking the Gitk utility. If a user were tricked into cloning a malicious
Git repository, an attacker could possibly use this issue to run arbitrary
commands. This issue only affected Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.10, and
Ubuntu 25.04. (CVE-2025-27614)

Johannes Sixt discovered that Git incorrectly managed file modification
constraints with Git GUI. If a user were tricked into editing a file in a
malicious Git repository, an attacker could possibly use this issue to
create or write to arbitrary files on the system. (CVE-2025-46835)

David Leadbeater discovered that Git incorrectly stripped CRLF characters
when editing configuration files. An attacker could possibly use this issue
to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-48384)

David Leadbeater discovered that Git incorrectly handled verification when
fetching remote Git repositories. An attacker could possibly use this issue
to perform protocol injection, leading to arbitrary code execution. This
issue only affected Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.10, and Ubuntu 25.04.
(CVE-2025-48385)

David Leadbeater discovered that Git incorrectly handled memory with the
wincred credential helper. An attacker could possibly use this issue to
cause a denial of service. (CVE-2025-48386)
articles.title: USN-7626-1: Git vulnerabilities
